entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Quintus Fabius Maximus Rullianus was a patrician, politician and soldier of the Roman Republic during the fourth and early third century BC. He was the son of Marcus Fabius Ambustus, of the patrician Fabii, was five times consul, dictator once, censor, and a hero of the Samnite Wars. He was brother to Marcus Fabius Ambustus, who was named after their father, and the grandfather of Quintus Fabius Maximus Verrucosus.
